What the job involves
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join Rula’s Patient Onboarding team
This team is focused on driving meaningful impact across the patient funnel
Our goal isn’t to get patients through the door, but to get them through the right door: an experience that feels fast, trustworthy, and frictionless enough that they actually complete it and get the care they need
In practice, that means building and evolving systems behind patient acquisition surfaces, registration flows, eligibility verification, and the end-to-end onboarding experience that converts someone who needs care into someone who’s getting it
In this role, you’ll design and deliver reliable, high-quality product experiences that directly impact growth and patient outcomes
You’ll own projects end-to-end, partnering closely with Product, Design, Analytics, and other engineers to run experiments, ship improvements, and iterate based on real data
Our work is experiment-heavy and we build systems for scale by optimizing for performance, correctness, and resilience as the business grows
You’ll also be a technical leader on the team: mentoring others, surfacing constraints and tradeoffs early, and modeling strong ownership, urgency, and follow-through
